name: The Shallows
desc:
The period of history following the [Canticlysm](event:the_canticlysm) in which technology and knowledge rapidly dwindled, ushering in a dark period of history in which little is recorded. Pushed to the very peaks of the world, mankind died in its droves to famine, conflict, and the horrors of [the Depths](location:the_depths) that emerged with [the Tides](event:the_tides).

With mankind adapting to the New World, [the Resurgence](event:the_resurgence) began.
